title: Jason & Lucia: GTA 6's best or worst love story
subject: jason
description:
Best thing or worst thing for Jason? 👇

What Rockstar has officially revealed about Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, the duo at the center of GTA 6, launching November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Based on Rockstar's official bios and game description.

scenes.text: Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing for Jason.
That's how Rockstar describes the couple at the heart of GTA 6.
Lucia sees a life with Jason as her way out, and Jason just wants things to finally get easier.
Then an easy score goes wrong, and they're pulled into a criminal conspiracy stretching across Leonida.
We'll see how it ends on November 19, but one line from Rockstar already says it all:
